contract: Resident supplied bounded X/U/G/D rectangular gated MLP 64x64→256→64 on 8x8 PEs. Typed three-matmul/SiLU/multiply graph; forward aligned two-hop projections, explicit gate-left carry, joined task resources, SDK map/DSR gating, immutable inputs and last-use buffer reuse. No intermediate host transfer. 8 SDK calls, exact target outputs; sampled mode additionally observes projection prefixes/gate/hidden/first operands, counter mode omits half intermediate-prefix observations (blocked mode retains final f32 accumulator readout). Corruption rejection, actual C++/device independent fsum/exp checks, matched adapted-source control and static ELF memory. No RMS/residual/full-model or hardware claim. Explicit half partials per physical K block, float32 merge and final half rounding; exact f32 accumulator snapshots, cross-block cancellation and subsequent warm-zero reset. Source control shares the precision library; independent original-input math remains separate.
